agent.label: FourierRidge
agent.reason: The regularized Fourier-feature map has the lowest pooled leave-one-trajectory-out free-running `y` RMSE: `0.061109` native `y` units (not supplied), across the three training trajectories with each validation trajectory fitted using only the other two. Its separate coordinate maps relax the shared-displacement hypothesis, while a centered ridge penalty prevents the poor validation of unregularized fits. No test data were accessed. Deadzone, Rational and Periodic retain compact alternative hard-threshold, smooth-rational and angular-feedback structures; their validation errors are larger. Residuals still suggest omitted input-response dynamics, so the recommendation is comparative, not a claim of exact identification.

ranking.label: oracle-based selection on test data
ranking.note: This ranking selects on the test data. It measures whether the pool contains an accurate model, not whether the agent can recognize that model without test data. A rank is not evidence of physical admissibility: each entry carries its unresolved requirements and any violation allowed by the user.
ranking.tie_rule: |S_a - S_b| <= 1e-12 * max(S_a, S_b) for consecutive candidates; tied candidates share a rank
